candidates.title: Don’t blindly follow foreign custody order: Supreme Court
candidates.excerpt: A bench of Justices J B Pardiwala and K V Viswanathan said cases already dealt with by foreign courts were coming before it time and again and their adjudication was not easy as they involved deeply emotional and sensitive issues.
